summary: Ran test_openai_param_compat.py (12 new cases) + 4 prior regression suites (test_ai_mode, test_admin_ai_mode_http, test_surgical_fixes, test_surgical_fixes_v2). 89/89 tests pass. HOWEVER, a critical functional gap was discovered: the OpenAI max_completion_tokens fix was applied at ONLY ONE of the two claimed call sites in freebuild_agent.py. The second call site in _stream_one_provider (line 9447-9448) still uses hardcoded `max_tokens=8000`, which means the user's reported BadRequest error in Hybrid (streaming) mode will still occur for gpt-5.x / o-series models.

critical.issue: Second OpenAI call site STILL uses hardcoded `max_tokens=8000` instead of the conditional `max_completion_tokens` selector. The fix was claimed in the review request to be applied at TWO call sites, but only the first one (_run_openai_compat_agent, line 8678) was actually patched. Streaming mode (Hybrid path) will continue to throw `Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model` for gpt-5.x and o-series models. User's live https://zenrex.ai error WILL reproduce.

Weak assertion gives FALSE confidence. It only checks `src.count('max_completion_tokens') >= 2`, which is satisfied by the comment on line 8671 + code on line 8676 (BOTH inside call site 1). The test passes even though the fix was applied to only one of the two OpenAI call sites. Recommended: assert the conditional `_token_kwargs` pattern appears at least 2 distinct line ranges, or grep for `chat.completions.create` and ensure none of them pass a raw `max_tokens=` kwarg for gpt-5/o models.

critical_code_review_comments: freebuild_agent.py is now 10,333 lines — far above the 700-line guideline. The fact that the main agent missed patching the second call site is a direct consequence. Strongly recommend splitting OpenAI/Anthropic/streaming logic into separate modules.

Duplicated kwarg-selection logic at two call sites is a DRY violation. Extract into a small helper `_openai_token_kwargs(model: str, n: int) -> dict` and import at both sites — this would have prevented the half-applied fix.
Line 8463 in another path also uses `max_tokens=8000` for Anthropic — confirmed it's Anthropic.messages.create so unaffected, but worth a quick audit to ensure no other OpenAI calls were missed.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Main agent intended to patch both OpenAI call sites (line ~8669 and line ~9441) but only applied the conditional kwarg selector to the first (line 8678 via _run_openai_compat_agent). The second call site in _stream_one_provider's openai branch (line 9447-9448) was missed — it still hardcodes `max_tokens=8000`. The accompanying source-introspection test was too loose (substring count >= 2) so it passed despite only one call site being fixed. REPRODUCTION: Run a Hybrid-mode build on Zenrex with model=gpt-5.5; the streaming path goes through _stream_one_provider → OpenAI branch (line 9447) → BadRequest 'Unsupported parameter max_tokens'. MITIGATION: (1) Replace lines 9447-9449 with the same conditional block used at lines 8672-8678. (2) Better: extract a helper `_openai_token_kwargs(model)` and call from both sites. (3) Tighten the test to assert two distinct conditional-pattern occurrences in source, not just substring count.
